cohort: 20 pregnant women treated with biosimilar infliximab (CT-P13) during pregnancy
finding: Treatment with biosimilar infliximab during pregnancy in women with IBD did not raise any new safety concerns, with most experiencing live births and no significant perinatal complications or birth defects.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 70% of the women, 79% of whom had a history of perianal disease.
